name: Nurglings

bonuses.name: Mischief Makers
bonuses.text: Nurglings complicate everything. Once they appear in a scene, any die roll that includes two or more 1s triggers a Wrath Complication. Characters with the Nurgle keyword are immune to this effect.

abilities.name: Frightful Form
abilities.text: Anyone that can see this threat must make a DN 2 Fear Test.

determination: Daemonic Determination: Spend 1 Ruin to roll 1d6. Daemons can roll Determination against Mortal Wounds. Any Wounds negated by Determination are ignored instead of being converted to Shock.
